'''JR-12''' was a [[Class four droid/Legends|fourth degree]] [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] programmed with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine personality]]. Bipedal and humanoid in structure, JR-12 operated as an independent security contractor on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A security droid, JR-12 was programmed to obey a master and protect them from harm. Circa [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], JR-12 was separated from his master and forced to operate independently. Finding work as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]], [[Security Guard/Legends|security guard]], and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] over his long career, JR-12 was based out of [[Morro Spaceport]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="MPQ" />
